title: Require the patient's ID document
summary: Clinic Preferences → ID document: required in the patient record and/or for an appointment to move to certain statuses.

steps.title: ID document
steps.details: Two independent options: one for the patient record and one for appointment statuses.

steps.title: Require ID document
steps.details: On: the patient record can't be saved without a document. Off (default) it can stay empty.

steps.title: Require it to change an appointment's status
steps.details: On: the appointment can't move to the chosen statuses if the patient has no document. When turned on it starts with "Completed". Cancelling is never blocked.

steps.title: Statuses that require it
steps.details: Tick the statuses that ask for it. When it's blocked, a notice shows up with a shortcut to the patient's details to add it.

steps.title: Save
steps.details: It applies to the whole clinic: calendar, My Workspace and the patient portal.
